scripts.typecheck: npm run check -w @ada/protocol && npm run check -w @ada/server && npm run check -w @ada/runner && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run check:docs && npm run check:hosted && npm run check:legacy
scripts.check:hosted: npm run typecheck && npm run check:hosted -w @ada/protocol && npm run check:issue1 -w @ada/server && npm run check:providers -w @ada/runner && npm run check:agents -w @ada/server && npm run build
scripts.check:legacy: npm run check:workspace && npm run check:scripted -w @ada/runner && npm run check:seed -w @ada/server && npm run check:e2e -w @ada/server && npm run check:gated -w @ada/server && npm run smoke
